definitions.explanation: A visa that permits the holder to work in a country. In Japan, this is an informal term for residence statuses that allow employment, such as {技術|ぎじゅつ}・{人文知識|じんぶんちしき}・{国際業務|こくさいぎょうむ} or {技能|ぎのう} visas.

examples.japanese: {就労|しゅうろう}ビザを{取得|しゅとく}した。
{就労|しゅうろう}ビザがないと{日本|にほん}で{働|はたら}けない。
examples.english: You can't work in Japan without a work visa.

examples.japanese: {就労|しゅうろう}ビザの{更新|こうしん}{手続|てつづ}きを{入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}で{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: I carried out the work visa renewal procedure at the immigration bureau.

notes:
Composed of {就労|しゅうろう} (employment, working) + ビザ (visa). In Japanese immigration law, the formal term is {在留資格|ざいりゅうしかく} (residence status) rather than ビザ (visa), but {就労|しゅうろう}ビザ is widely used in everyday conversation. Japan has multiple categories of work-related residence statuses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザを{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain a work visa
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザを{更新|こうしん}する: to renew a work visa
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザの{申請|しんせい}: work visa application
- {就労|しゅうろう}ビザの{種類|しゅるい}: types of work visas

RELATED WORDS:
- {在留資格|ざいりゅうしかく}: residence status (formal/legal term)
- {労働許可|ろうどうきょか}: work permit
- {留学|りゅうがく}ビザ: student visa
- {観光|かんこう}ビザ: tourist visa
